title: CrowdStrike to Acquire Dreadnode for Automated AI Security Testing | CrowdStrike
summary: CrowdStrike to acquire Dreadnode, bringing automated AI security testing to the Falcon platform to find and fix AI weaknesses before production.
body_markdown:
*Dreadnode will extend the Falcon platform with automated testing of AI models, applications, and agents to build AI trust – finding and fixing weaknesses before they reach production*


**AUSTIN, Texas and Fal.Con Europe 2026, Barcelona – November 3, 2026 –**[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/) (NASDAQ: CRWD) today announced it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire[Dreadnode](https://dreadnode.io/) , a leader in Automated AI Security Testing. Dreadnode will extend the[Falcon platform](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/) to continuously test every AI model, application, and agent for security weaknesses before deployment.


“Enterprises are deploying AI faster than they can prove it is secure. A model can be jailbroken, an agent can be manipulated, and most organizations have no way to find those flaws until the AI is already in production,” said George Kurtz, CEO and founder of CrowdStrike. “With Dreadnode, CrowdStrike will give every enterprise the power to trust AI and deploy faster, with confidence.”


**Building AI Trust: Securing the AI Enterprises Build and Deploy** AI has broken the security testing model, which has traditionally been applied against code that behaves the same way every time. AI models and agents are probabilistic, can be jailbroken or manipulated through prompt injection, and fail in ways conventional testing was not designed to catch. Those weaknesses live inside the model and the agent’s reasoning loop, the layer conventional testing never reaches. Identifying and fixing AI weaknesses needs to happen at the speed AI is being deployed.


With this acquisition, Dreadnode will extend the Falcon platform into the layer where enterprises build and test AI, delivering Automated AI Security Testing capabilities that extend CrowdStrike's leadership in the AI Detection and Response (AIDR) category.[Automated AI Security Testing](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/solutions/automated-ai-security-testing/) will be generally available in Q4 FY27.


**Dreadnode: Automated AI Security Testing on the Falcon Platform**
With Dreadnode, CrowdStrike will deliver Automated AI Security Testing on the Falcon platform:


-


**Automated AI Security Testing:** Describe what to test in plain language. Dreadnode runs more than 100 known AI attack strategies, including jailbreaks, prompt injection, and multi-turn and agent-specific attacks, against the models, agent reasoning loops, applications, and MCP servers that power enterprise AI.


-


**Findings, Remediation, and Framework Mapping:** Dreadnode ranks findings by severity, maps them to OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, OWASP Agentic Security (ASI01-ASI10), MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF, and delivers exportable reports so teams can make go/no-go decisions before deployment.


-


**Model and Component Scanning:** Dreadnode scans AI models, model repositories, and components for vulnerabilities before they reach production.


-


**Human-in-the-Loop Review:** Operators reclassify findings, adjust severity, and document their reasoning, with dashboard metrics recomputing automatically.


-


**Falcon Guardian and SafeMind Integration:** Dreadnode findings will feed[Falcon Guardian](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/falcon-guardian-aidr/) as policy recommendations, so a weakness found in testing strengthens runtime protection, and Dreadnode testing data will strengthen CrowdStrike's[SafeMind](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/about-us/cyber-superintelligence-lab/) models.


**Expanding CrowdStrike’s Cyber Superintelligence Lab**
The Dreadnode team will join CrowdStrike's Cyber Superintelligence Lab, deepening the company's bench of AI security researchers. Dreadnode’s technology will also sharpen how SafeMind measures the security and cyber capabilities of frontier models, advancing CrowdStrike's research into securing AI systems.


“AI fails in ways traditional testing was never designed to catch, and the people best equipped to find those failures think like attackers. We founded Dreadnode to expose those weaknesses before AI reaches production,” said Brad Palm, CEO of Dreadnode. “As part of CrowdStrike, we will bring Automated AI Security Testing to every enterprise, helping teams confidently find and fix weaknesses.”


**Transaction Details** The purchase price is contemplated to be paid predominantly in cash and includes a portion to be delivered in the form of stock subject to vesting conditions. The proposed acquisition is expected to close during CrowdStrike’s fourth quarter of FY27, subject to customary closing conditions.


**About CrowdStrike**[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/) (NASDAQ: CRWD), a global cybersecurity leader, has redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced cloud-native platform for protecting critical areas of enterprise risk – endpoints and cloud workloads, identity and data.


Powered by the CrowdStrike Security Cloud and world-class AI, the CrowdStrike Falcon® platform leverages real-time indicators of attack, threat intelligence, evolving adversary tradecraft, and enriched telemetry from across the enterprise to deliver hyper-accurate detections, automated protection and remediation, elite threat hunting, and prioritized observability of vulnerabilities.


Purpose-built in the cloud with a single lightweight-agent architecture, the Falcon platform delivers rapid and scalable deployment, superior protection and performance, reduced complexity, and immediate time-to-value.
